pass3_taxid_length.rule: or(and(eq(taxon_id,T),ge(genome_length,lo),le(genome_length,hi))) on the GTDB ncbi_taxid and its merged.dmp target, window +-0.01 of genome_size; accept only when the window holds exactly one live record, not chosen or accession-claimed by another representative, with no different assembly accession

taxid_rename_exemption.rule: a biosample match with a taxid mismatch is kept when its BioSample equals GTDB's and |genome_length - genome_size| / genome_size <= 0.01

length_gate.rule: reject a non-Deprecated/Plasmid candidate when |genome_length - genome_size| / genome_size > 0.05 for wildcard_core/metadata_gca/biosample, or > 0.1 for exact/prefix_swap whose genome_id taxid prefix is a mismatch; taxid_length candidates must be within 0.01; a candidate without a length is kept
length_gate.note_on_counter: counts every candidate failing the gate, including those the biosample guard had already rejected; the TSV keeps the guard's reason

pass3_taxid_length.rule: or(and(eq(taxon_id,T),ge(genome_length,lo),le(genome_length,hi))) on the GTDB ncbi_taxid and its merged.dmp target, window +-0.01 of genome_size; accept only when the window holds exactly one live record, not chosen or accession-claimed by another representative, with no different assembly accession

label_mismatch_on_sequence_correct_recor.note: chosen accession matches whose genome_length is within 1% of GTDB's genome_size (the right sequence) but whose BV-BRC taxon_id label and/or genome_id prefix disagree with gtdb_ncbi_taxid. crossed_biosample_differs: the record also carries another BioSample (crossed-label BV-BRC records, e.g. GCF_002020805.1 -> 1918949.3); same_biosample_relabelled: same BioSample, the taxon was reassigned after BV-BRC took the record. Either way integration must take taxon_id from gtdb_ncbi_taxid, not from bvbrc_taxon_id or the genome_id prefix.

The chosen record's own label (bvbrc_taxon_id; compared in bvbrc_label_taxid_consistent) and its genome_id prefix (taxid_consistent) can belong to another strain: crossed-label BV-BRC records keep the right sequence (length equals GTDB's genome_size) but another strain's taxon_id and BioSample.
Unmapped = bvbrc_genome_id == '' (match_type unmapped, deprecated_only, biosample_rejected, length_rejected).
candidates lists every record found, including those in rejected_candidates and Deprecated/Plasmid ones; membership checks must use bvbrc_genome_id.
taxid_length (pass 3) rows rest on taxid + genome length within 1% only; flag or exclude them where a same-assembly guarantee matters.
length_ratio is bvbrc_genome_length / gtdb_genome_size of the chosen record; the gate thresholds are in stats.length_gate.

60 chosen exact/prefix_swap records whose taxid agrees differ from the GTDB genome_size by more than 10% (39 more by 5%-10%); the length gate tests accession matches only when their taxid disagrees, so filter on length_ratio where a same-sequence guarantee matters.
